intro: Nellis Architecture is a Dubai architecture studio for ultra-luxurious villas and exceptional investment projects. Our work includes new-build villas and renovations on Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Hills, Jumeirah Bay Island and Palm Jebel Ali, and in Abu Dhabi on Saadiyat and Nareel Island. We also design homes in Greece and Sierra Leone.

seo.title: Architecture Firm in Dubai & UAE: Villa Projects | Nellis
seo.description: Nellis Architecture, an architecture firm in Dubai, UAE: luxury villa projects, new builds and renovations on Palm Jumeirah, Emirates Hills and Saadiyat.
